conclusion.summary:
DIAGNOSIS. The baseline (train job_94e3cd4b69364363, 45 steps, seed 41; evaluate job_0bfcc47ba1af4ea6) has reference accuracy 0.984 but both-correct 0.2625. By_group report art_229b7da2b4f447ed_report: adjacent pairs 0/701 both-correct, 2-3 apart 8/1133 (0.7%), 4+ apart 1042/2166 (48%). Reference accuracy stays about 0.97-0.99 in every stratum. So the model is right on the original but fails on the twin, mostly on close-order pairs. This fits reliance on the recorder shortcut (98% label agreement), which is the likely mechanism. I did not test it directly, for example with a weight-edit on the recorder weight. The invest.pairs.margin-probe and sign-agreement runs (jobs job_884b28d3fbff407c and job_b2d17d6d9b144ea0) are consistent with it, but I did not read their outputs in this session.

REPAIR. Group-balanced training (lab.learning.group-balanced-ema, balance_groups=true) was tried two ways. As a from-scratch trial (job_d4a0f5677d044335; eval job_17f2fecdfef04841) it gave both-correct 0.467 but reference accuracy only 0.7125, which breaks the 0.02 guardrail. As a checkpoint branch from the 45-step baseline to step 90 (job_9d53464d1180475e; eval job_a3b8e250bed24c82; by-group art_ae66f73be84c48ee_report) it gave both-correct 0.78475 and reference accuracy 0.9955. Per stratum, both-correct is 0.24 adjacent, 0.71 for 2-3 apart and 0.999 for 4+ apart. The confirmation arms reproduce these numbers exactly: baseline job_841aa0ca84834311 gives 0.2625 / 0.984 and candidate job_9a9244d612d04f8e gives 0.78475 / 0.9955. The point difference is about +0.52 in both-correct, with reference accuracy up by 0.0115, so the guardrail is not breached on point estimates.

ASSESSMENT. Evidence plan plan_cbdbf66587bb was frozen and launched against claim_ac80cc5221c0 under rule early-repair. Both arms' jobs have succeeded. I could not see the paired-ci assessor's verdict in my context, so I am not reporting a pass or fail. The charter decision, a paired-difference CI at 0.95 with min effect 0.05, is the assessor's to make and should be read from the plan record.

LIMITS. (1) Only one seed (41) and one evaluation draw (data seed 76102, 4000 pairs) were used, so there is a single cluster and the CI cannot reflect seed-to-seed variance. (2) The candidate got 45 extra training steps (90 vs 45) and the baseline was not continued to 90 unbalanced, so the repair effect is confounded with extra training. (3) Adjacent pairs remain weak at 0.24 both-correct. (4) The recorder-shortcut mechanism is inferred, not causally tested. (5) The behavior check (job_76278cf38497487e) and export (export_31e7fc6eb795) cover checkpoint art_9d53464d1180475e_checkpoint, the branch checkpoint. The behavior-check report contents were not reviewed here. (6) The authored component invest.pairs.sign-agreement@1.0.0 was published and run, but its results were not read in this session.

SCOPE: OrderedSwitchNet, the switch-order test split, data seed 76102, training seed 41, group-balanced continuation from step 45 to step 90.
